events.verdict: Wells (MEM) maintains verticality and legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Edey (MEM) and Zubac (LAC) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Edey (MEM) reaches for the ball and makes marginal contact with Zubac's (LAC) arm as they pursues the rebound.
Coward (MEM) is moving alongside Collins' (LAC) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the drive.
Spencer (MEM) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Zubac (LAC) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Zubac (LAC) is moving alongside Wells' (MEM) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together at the end of the drive.
Coward (MEM) maintains verticality and legally contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Dunn (LAC) initiates contact with Coward's (MEM) arm and the contact affects his SQBR.
Batum (LAC) initiates contact with Wells' (MEM) arm during his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Zubac (LAC) is firming up when he makes marginal contact with Wells (MEM) on the perimeter while setting the pick.

As Spencer (MEM) attempts to move through the triple team, he brings the ball toward Batum's (LAC) right leg and makes some contact causing the ball to become loose. The contact to Batum's leg is incidental.
Coward (MEM) directly contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Leonard's hand after the release.
Harden (LAC) commits a take foul on Wells (MEM).
